context.issue_title: Test isolation BLOCKER — killIdleConnections() terminates all idle DB connections

task.description:
Step 2b — HARD GATE validation. Review the design artefact src/design/iss0602_test_isolation.md before BACKEND-DEV can start implementing.

Steps:
  1. Read handoffs/WF03-gh414-20260804/step-2b-code-design-validator.json in full.
  2. Read docs/issue-reports/ISS-0602-diagnosis.yaml (the upstream diagnosis).
  3. Read the design at src/design/iss0602_test_isolation.md.
  4. Run per-artefact checks:
       python tools/lint_design_artefact.py src/design/iss0602_test_isolation.md
     Must exit 0 with no BLOCKER/MAJOR.
  5. Verify the 4 acceptance criteria from issue #414 are all covered in the design:
       a. killIdleConnections() no longer terminates other test processes' connections — verify the SQL change AND application_name setter are both described.
       b. Concurrent zig build test-integration completes without administrator-command terminations — verify the regression test exercises this scenario.
       c. Connection cleanup remains bounded — verify the design does NOT delete killIdleConnections() (only scopes it).
       d. A regression test proves one test process cannot terminate another — verify tests/integration/iss0602_cross_test_isolation_test.zig is described with two-harness setup.
  6. Verify NO implementation code is present (only signatures, SQL strings, behaviour descriptions).
  7. Verify all public function signatures are listed: setTestApplicationName, GetTestApplicationName, killIdleConnections (with optional prefix), TEST_APPLICATION_NAME_PREFIX constant.
  8. Verify error taxonomy is documented for SET application_name failure and pg_terminate_backend guard.
  9. Verify dependencies are limited to in-file imports (no new modules).
  10. Verify the documents issue #414 acceptance criteria item-by-item.

Return PASS only when every check above is satisfied. ANY failure = FAIL with specific issues.
acceptance_criteria: python tools/lint_design_artefact.py src/design/iss0602_test_isolation.md exits 0 with no BLOCKER/MAJOR
Design covers all 4 acceptance criteria from issue #414
No implementation code (only signatures, SQL strings, behaviour)
All public function signatures listed (setTestApplicationName, GetTestApplicationName, killIdleConnections with optional prefix, TEST_APPLICATION_NAME_PREFIX)
Error taxonomy exists for SET application_name failure and pid != pg_backend_pid() guard
Return next_action: 'Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 3 implement fix)' on PASS

result.summary: Design reworked REWORK 1 — per-process opaque owner tag (uid_<12hex>, std.crypto.random + std.posix.getrandom fallback, std.atomic.Value(?Tag) cache), parameterised SELECT set_config('application_name', $1, false), killIdleConnections filters by application_name = $1 (exact equality, NOT LIKE-prefix). Cross-process regression now in-scope as tests/integration/iss0602_cross_process_isolation_test.zig using std.process.Child to spawn two child binaries. Ownership-guard failure contract specified: 0 rows terminated = no-op; defensive post-check for cross-owner rows = error.OwnerTagMismatch. 5-stage ASCII data-flow diagram. All 6 BLOCKER+MAJOR issues from the previous validation cycle addressed. Lint: OK - 1 file(s) checked, no issues.
